en.headline: Sun says Fu Tai siblings will not go straight home
en.dek: The welfare secretary said social workers judge the three children should go to temporary residential care after hospital checks.
body: Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun said on Friday that three siblings in a Tuen Mun suspected child-abuse case should not return home immediately after leaving hospital.

Sun said the girl who was seen carrying two large bags of canned beer, and her younger sister and brother, were still undergoing health checks. They could be discharged as early as Friday or Saturday. The Social Welfare Department has assessed that they should instead be placed in temporary residential care.

He said the department would call a multi-disciplinary case conference with social workers, teachers, medical staff and police to review the family's situation, safety risks and longer-term welfare needs. Because the parties need time to prepare, he expected the meeting to take about a week to convene. If the family setting is found unsuitable, one option would be to apply to the court for a care or protection order. He said the children would not be sent home before a decision is made.

Sun also said the department was reviewing the family's Comprehensive Social Security Assistance claim. If serious irregularities such as concealment or deception were found, the case would be referred to police. The parents were arrested earlier on suspicion of child abuse and were released on bail pending further enquiries.

zh.headline: 孫玉菡：富泰三姊弟出院後暫不回家
zh.dek: 勞福局局長表示，社署評估三名兒童現階段不宜即時回家，出院後會安排入住臨時住宿。
body: 勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡周五表示，屯門富泰邨一宗懷疑虐兒個案中的三名姊弟，離開醫院後不宜即時回家。
孫玉菡說，早前被途人發現手提兩大袋罐裝啤酒的女童，以及她的妹妹和弟弟，仍在醫院接受健康檢查，最快周五或周六出院。社會福利署評估認為，三姊弟現階段應由院舍提供臨時住宿照顧。
他表示，社署會聯同社工、老師、醫護人員及警方盡快召開多專業個案會議，檢視家庭狀況、安全風險及長遠福利需要。由於各方需要預備，預計約一星期才能召開。若評估認為家庭狀況不適切，其中一個跟進方向是向法庭申請照顧或保護令。他說，在有定案之前不會讓三名兒童回家。
孫玉菡又說，社署正檢視該家庭領取綜合社會保障援助的情況，若發現瞞報或欺騙等嚴重違規，會轉交警方跟進。女童的父母早前涉嫌虐兒被捕，其後獲准保釋候查。
